title: Cookbook Chapter
description: A single chapter of the cookbook, containing a hierarchical tree of sections whose leaves reference entry identifiers.

Section.title: Chapter Section
Section.description: A named subdivision of a chapter or another section. Sections may be nested arbitrarily deep. Leaf sections carry a list of entry identifiers in the order they appear in the text.

title.description: The display title of the section.

entryIDs.description: Ordered list of entry identifiers belonging directly to this section.

items.description: An entry identifier matching the _id field in entries.json.

chapter.description: The chapter number expressed as a Roman numeral (e.g., 'I', 'XIV').

title.description: The display title of the chapter.

introduction.description: Introductory paragraphs for the chapter as a whole.

sections.description: The top-level sections within this chapter.
